Scan an R Project for Dependencies, System Libraries, and Scientific Toolchains

Source: R/scanner.R
scan_project.Rd

Recursively inspects an R analysis project, Quarto manuscript, R Markdown report, R package, or Shiny application. Parses R scripts, notebook code chunks, DESCRIPTION, renv.lock, _quarto.yml, Shiny entry points, and native source files to build a full-stack dependency and toolchain profile.

Usage

scan_project(path = ".", exclude = NULL, custom_sysreqs = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to the project root directory. Defaults to ".".

exclude

Optional character vector of additional relative paths or directory names to ignore during scanning.

custom_sysreqs

Optional named list mapping R package names to Debian/Ubuntu apt system packages to merge with sysreqs_db().

Value

An S3 object of class rcapsule_scan containing:

  • project_path, project_name, project_type, roles, entrypoint

  • r_version, has_renv, renv_lock_path, has_description, has_quarto_yml

  • shiny_async: logical indicating async worker patterns in Shiny apps

  • files: tibble of scanned project files

  • packages: tibble of discovered R packages (package, version, source, found_in, is_base, required)

  • sysreqs: tibble of resolved OS apt system dependencies (apt_package, stage, required_by, source)

  • toolchains: named list of toolchain detection summaries (cpp, cmdstan, tmb, jags, rust, java, python, quarto, latex)

  • python_packages: character vector of detected Python packages/requirements

  • seeds_detected: integer vector of static set.seed() literals discovered

  • git: list of Git repository metadata

  • scanned_at: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("rcapsule_scan_demo_")
dir.create(tmp)
writeLines(c("library(stats)", "x <- rnorm(10)"), file.path(tmp, "analysis.R"))
sc <- scan_project(tmp)
sc
#> 
#> ── rcapsule Project Scan: rcapsule_scan_demo_18fb74c4d459 ──────────────────────
#> • Path: /tmp/RtmpFZcrpm/rcapsule_scan_demo_18fb74c4d459
#> • Project type: "analysis" (roles: analysis)
#> • R version: "4.6.2" | renv.lock: FALSE | DESCRIPTION: FALSE
#> • Entrypoint: "analysis.R"
#> • Files scanned: 1
#> 
#> ── R Packages (0 non-base) ──
#> 
#> None detected (base R only)
#> 
#> ── Detected Toolchains (0) ──
#> 
#> Standard R runtime only
#> 
#> ── OS System Dependencies (0 apt packages) ──
#> 
#> None required
unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
